# participation part

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationPart`](gmeow-participationPart.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationPart>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The musical part or role the participant performed — e.g. bass line, lead vocal, first violin. Range intentionally open (the [`tenurePosition`](gmeow-tenurePosition.md) precedent) so a part may be a segment, a voice, a named chair, or any other entity. Functional per relator.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PerformanceParticipation`](../classes/gmeow-PerformanceParticipation.md) -> `?`; functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:participationPart`](gmeow-participationPart.md) from [`gmeow:PerformanceParticipation`](../classes/gmeow-PerformanceParticipation.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Wedding

- **Source:** [`slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding)#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding

```turtle
# --- Reified participations: the two principals and the officiant, with roles.
#     A withdrawn or disputed role would coexist as another Participation
#     (displayable false, or standpoint-indexed) — never overwritten (P9/P10).
ex:partAlex a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:alex ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .

ex:partSam a gmeow:Participation ;
    gmeow:participationEvent ex:wedding ;
    gmeow:participationParticipant ex:sam ;
    gmeow:participationRole gmeow:roleParticipantPrincipal .
```
